factual_claims.source_evidence: Letter from the Chair & CEO states 52 new customers were added in 2025. Market Glance section states 283 active customers at year-end 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Its transition from a standalone consolidation product to the Konsolidator Suite was a major strategic development.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Strategy section describes the transition from a single consolidation tool to the Konsolidator Suite as a central pillar of the 2025-2027 strategy.

factual_claims.claim: The company launched a financial data management solution, continued developing its FP&A tool, and signed its first FP&A customers ahead of the January 2026 launch.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Product section states: Financial Data Management Solution launched in April 2025; FP&A tool development began in May 2025; first FP&A customers signed in December 2025 ahead of January 2026 launch.

factual_claims.claim: Partner-led sales accounted for 38% of new customers, compared with 22% in 2024, supported by agreements including Exsitec in Sweden and Norway.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Partner-Driven Growth section states 38% of new customers came through partners (vs 22% in 2024) and highlights the Exsitec partnership agreement signed in April 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Iberia became the third-largest market, although the subsidiary generated a DKK 2.0m EBIT loss.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Insight: Konsolidator Iberia section states it became the third-largest market. Financial Review 2025 states Konsolidator Iberia had an EBIT loss of DKK 2.0m.

factual_claims.claim: Cash flow improved materially but remained negative from operating activities at DKK 1.0m, compared with DKK 9.2m in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash Flow Statement shows cash flow from operating activities was DKK (1,047k) (2025) vs DKK (9,171k) (2024).

factual_claims.claim: After investing and financing flows, net cash flow was positive by DKK 11,000, leaving cash of only DKK 0.4m.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash Flow Statement shows net cash flow of DKK 11k (2025). Balance Sheet shows cash and cash equivalents of DKK 370k (0.37m, rounded to 0.4m) at year-end 2025.

factual_claims.claim: The Group’s consolidated equity was negative at DKK 3.6m despite DKK 4.8m raised through private placements.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Balance Sheet shows equity attributable to owners of the company as DKK (3,583k) (2025). Shareholder Information states DKK 4.8m was raised via two private placements in 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Loan repayments began in 2025, and refinancing is a priority for 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Credit Institutions and Other Loans section states loan repayments commenced in July 2025. Outlook 2026 section identifies refinancing loans as a priority for 2026.

factual_claims.claim: Management guides for 2026 CARR and revenue of DKK 27–29m, EBITDA of DKK 1–2m, and churn of 6–9%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Outlook 2026 section provides exactly these guidance figures: CARR DKK 27-29m, Revenue DKK 27-29m, EBITDA DKK 1-2m, Churn 6-9%.

numerical_claims.source_evidence: Financial highlights and key figures table: Revenue 2025 DKK 25,282k, 2024 DKK 20,268k
